title: NEW STORY COLLECTION EVENT: THE BLACK FOREST WILLS A DREAM
lines: 01 NEW STORY COLLECTION EVENT: THE BLACK FOREST WILLS A DREAM
EVENT STAGE DURATION: February 27, 2024, 10:00 (UTC-7) – March 5, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10
EVENT STAGES MAINLY DROP: Guiding Figurines, Materials, etc.

DETAILS: The Black Forest Wills A Dream event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain Guiding Figurines by clearing all the stages except Annihilation and Extreme Mode to redeem event rewards and Information Fragments at the Treehollow Stores. Information Fragments can be used to unlock the stories in Story Collection.
Treehollow Stores
DURATION: February 27, 2024, 10:00 (UTC-7) – March 8, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
REWARDS: MARTHE [Coral Coast] - Holiday HD29 for Ambriel, Information Fragments, Module Materials, Elite Materials, Battle Records, LMD, Recruitment Permits, etc.
NOTE: After the event ends, the event stories will be recorded in Special Operation.
02 LIMITED-TIME HEADHUNTING OPEN – THE WOE-CLEANSING HURRICANE
DURATION: February 27, 2024, 10:00 (UTC-7) – March 12, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, the Limited-time Headhunting, [The Woe-cleansing Hurricane], opens and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate from this Limited Headhunting
★★★★★★: Typhon
★★★★★: Santalla / Proviso

Note: This is a [Standard Headhunting]. If you make 150 headhunting attempts without receiving the current rate-up 6-star Operator, the next 6-star operator received is guaranteed to be the current rate-up 6-star Operator.
03 NEW OPERATOR NOW AVAILABLE
DETAILS: The following operators will become available in other [Standard Headhuntings] after March 12, 2024, 04:00 (UTC-7).

Typhon and Santalla will gain more trust in the event stages during February 27, 2024, 10:00 (UTC-7) – March 5, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
